title: From Generative Engines to Actionable Simulators: The Imperative of Physical Grounding in World Models
author: Zhikang Chen; Tingting Zhu
summary: World models simulate how environments change, helping AI plan actions by imagining futures instead of just reacting. They must understand physical laws and cause-effect relationships, not just create realistic images. The future of world models focuses on reliable, actionable simulations that support decision-making and learning in complex situations.
